vulnerabilities.description: bzip2 contains an off-by-one error in the bzip2recover utility. When processing a specially crafted file, the application performs an out-of-bounds write to a global buffer, resulting in memory corruption and a crash (denial of service).
vulnerabilities.recommendation: No action required. Liquibase Secure never invokes the bzip2recover utility or any bzip2 API at runtime.

ratings.justification: The advisory is specific to the bzip2recover utility; Liquibase Secure's runtime never invokes that tool or any bzip2 API path that would reach it.

analysis.detail: This off-by-one flaw is specific to the bzip2recover recovery utility, not the core bzip2 compression library. Liquibase Secure's container only ever execs the Liquibase Java CLI at runtime; a review of the container's runtime path found no invocation of bzip2recover, bzip2, bunzip2, or any bzip2 API. libbz2 ships only as an inherited base-image library dependency.
